en: On the physical row \(\beta=\xi=0\), \(\mu=\gamma^2\in(0,1]\), I use \(h=\mu^{-1}\Pi_0q\) and \(r=Q_0q\). The exact mean cancellation removes \(\mu^{-1}\) from the homogeneous generator and gives an all-start finite-transient bound in the \(X_\mu\) norm. Its rate is only viscous; physical kinetic control, Squire, Bloch, nonlinearity, and Clay remain OPEN.

en: The unconditional algebraic fact is the leakage formula for \(\mathscr B_0\), whose kernel is exactly the tangent line; after multiplication by \(-ic\), only \(c\ne0\) yields noninvariance, return coupling, and higher harmonics for the full \(\mathscr A_0\). A finite-dimensional deletion is not an invariant quotient of that nonzero-coupling evolution.

en: The tangent amplitude does not force the complement; the complement can still force the amplitude. Both sides are invariant if and only if \(\psi_d=-\mathscr A^*\psi\), whose gapless OS form is forward anti-parabolic.

zh: uniform dichotomy 只在固定 \(d\)，或满足 \(\inf_d\|\phi(d)\|_2>0\) 的 compact \(d\)-interval 上表述。实际 OS off-block 还乘 \(|c|\)，因此其发散结论只沿 \(|c|/g\to\infty\) 的路径成立。这不声称无共同空间识别时 \(g=0\) 与 \(g>0\) 的算子范数不连续，也不排除像 \(X_\mu\) 那样明确支付权重的 theorem。
en: The uniform dichotomy is stated only at fixed \(d\), or under \(\inf_d\|\phi(d)\|_2>0\) on a compact \(d\)-interval. The actual OS off-block also carries \(|c|\), so its divergence conclusion holds only along paths with \(|c|/g\to\infty\). This makes no claim, absent a common-space identification, that the operator norms at \(g=0\) and \(g>0\) are discontinuous, and it does not exclude a theorem that explicitly pays weights as \(X_\mu\) does.
